title: ANRF ₹1 Lakh Crore RDI Fund & Deep-Tech Startup 20-Year Recognition
summary: Dr. Jitendra Singh launched 1st call of TDB under ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development & Innovation Fund of ANRF (2-4% interest, up to 15-yr tenure, TRL 4+).

blocks.content: **Overview**: Dr. Jitendra Singh launched 1st call of TDB under ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development & Innovation Fund of ANRF (2-4% interest, up to 15-yr tenure, TRL 4+).

items: **ANRF launches ₹1 Lakh Crore RDI Fund first call under TDB** (Page 29): Dr. Jitendra Singh launched 1st call of TDB under ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development & Innovation Fund of ANRF (2-4% interest, up to 15-yr tenure, TRL 4+).

**DPIIT revises start-up definition: Deep-tech up to 20 years and ₹300 crore** (Page 30): DPIIT revised 2019 rules: Deep-tech start-ups recognized up to 20 years (turnover ₹300 Cr); non-deep-tech turnover raised to ₹200 Cr (10 years).
**BIRAC-RDI Fund for Biotechnology launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh** (Page 38): DBT's BIRAC appointed second-level manager to deploy ₹2,000 Cr under ₹1L Cr RDI framework.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Indigenous R&D Financing & Deep-Tech Policy. ₹1L Cr concessional fund (2-4%) and 20-year deep-tech startup recognition.
